required_by: LSMC-OD-21 (owner decision 2026-10-08): "INVALIDATED must be reachable; add a fixture proving it."
status: DATA_AND_WORKED_PROOF_ONLY -- not wired into tests/ (out of this session's scope)

symbol_profile.note: Any of USDJPY, XAUUSD, BTCUSDT, ETHUSDT. Values are synthetic and chosen for clean decimal arithmetic; no pip or tick size is required because the ATR term is already in price units.

inputs.stop_replaced_basis_note: SWEEP_EXTREME, the LSMC-OD-02 ruling replaced on 2026-10-08

resolver_precedence: AMBIGUOUS_SAME_BAR if target_hit and (stopped or invalidated); else TARGET_REACHED if target_hit; else STOP_REACHED if stopped; else INVALIDATED if invalidated; else OPEN

cases.purpose: PROOF: INVALIDATED is reachable for a LONG under SWEEP_EXTREME_ATR_BUFFER.
cases.significance: Under the replaced SWEEP_EXTREME basis the same bar resolved STOP_REACHED, because low 149.990 <= stop 150.000. The ATR buffer is what makes INVALIDATED reachable.

cases.purpose: PROOF: INVALIDATED is reachable for a SHORT under SWEEP_EXTREME_ATR_BUFFER.
cases.significance: Mirror of L1. Note the stop carries no spread term: SWEEP_EXTREME_ATR_BUFFER is not C10-B. See LSMC-OD-29.

cases.purpose: CONTROL: the buffer does not make STOP_REACHED unreachable.
CONTROL: a genuine same-bar tie still resolves to AMBIGUOUS_SAME_BAR (LSMC-OD-12 / LSMC-OD-26).
cases.significance: Stays unresolved and is counted separately. M1 resolution is deferred to v1.1 (LSMC-OD-26).

reachability_window.long: INVALIDATED fires when bar.low > (sweep_extreme - buffer) AND bar.close < sweep_extreme. Window width is exactly `buffer`.
reachability_window.short: INVALIDATED fires when bar.high < (sweep_extreme + buffer) AND bar.close > sweep_extreme. Window width is exactly `buffer`.
reachability_window.degenerate_case: As atr -> 0 the window width -> 0 and INVALIDATED becomes unreachable again. c10_stop_policy.compute_c10_stop raises only on atr < 0, never on atr == 0. Raised as LSMC-OD-28; NOT resolved.
